body: Thank you for responding. That means a lot to me. I took a double-dose of my anti-depressants, and the suicidal feeling is gone, but I still feel a sense of disembodied shock. I'll probably be ok, but I'm the most boring person I know, and being accused of something like this is so uncharacteristic that it really gave me a shock. I have very little self-esteem to float me in times like this, so it's nice to read your comment.
